tools.name: check_cv
tools.description: Scores a CV from 0 to 100 on structure, contact details, dates, length, bullet quality and ATS-friendliness, and lists the most important problems with a fix for each. Takes the CV as plain text. Rule-based and deterministic: no AI is used, nothing is stored, and the text is not kept after the call.

tools.name: match_cv_to_job
tools.description: Compares a CV with a job ad and returns a 0 to 100 keyword match score, the ad's keywords the CV already contains, and the ones it is missing (skills and tools flagged separately).
